title: Proposition Player #5 of 6 DC Vertigo 2000 Bill Willingham John Bolton Cover
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Proposition Player #5 (of 6) (April 2000), DC Vertigo. Written by Bill Willingham, art by Paul Guinan and Ron Randall; painted cover by John Bolton. Suggested for mature readers. Direct sales, $2.50 cover price.

Back cover: NextPlanetOver.com ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
